text: Here, surrounded by glass and colorful displays, I sense the intersection of curiosity and utility. The first image, bright and orderly, evokes anticipation—almost as if knowledge is waiting behind these transparent walls. Moving into the second scene, I feel energized, stimulated by bold letters, screens, and books, which suggest a celebration of research and development. The environment feels like a temple to progress, invention, and thoughtful inquiry. I feel small yet engaged, conscious of being just one questioning mind among many who have and will pass through this space.
